resources.string: Swipe up to go Home or open Recents while keeping one-handed mode active. Turn off to swipe up to exit one-handed mode.
Checking system support and Xposed activation
Enable the module in LSPosed, select System Framework and SystemUI, then restart your device.

With gesture navigation enabled, swipe down from the bottom gesture bar while your device is unlocked and in portrait orientation. On Xiaomi devices, you can also swipe down from the bottom gesture area when the gesture bar is hidden.\n\nSwipe down on the left half to anchor the screen at the bottom left, or on the right half to anchor it at the bottom right.

Tap the blank area outside the scaled screen to exit. By default, swiping up from the bottom gesture bar also exits one-handed mode.

Enable “Keep Home and Recents gestures” to swipe up to go Home or open Recents while keeping one-handed mode active. Use the blank area to exit.

Tap the settings button in the blank area to open this app. Rotating the screen or turning it off also exits one-handed mode.

The scale is the width and height of the smaller screen as a percentage of the original. At 70%, both dimensions are 70% of their original size. The content and corner radius scale proportionally.\n\nThe presets are 80%, 70%, and 60%. A smaller value brings more of the screen within reach. Choose Custom to adjust the scale from 20% to 90%. Changes apply the next time you enter one-handed mode. If it is already active, it exits and re-enters automatically.

After enabling the module and restarting, another app can send a broadcast with action io.githuh.onehandedmode.action.START to package com.android.systemui. The sender needs no root or system permission.

Shell command:
am broadcast -a io.githuh.onehandedmode.action.START -p com.android.systemui

The screen opens on the right by default. Add --es side left to open on the left, or --es side right for the right. The current scale applies. Repeated requests keep an active mode open. Entry requires an unlocked device in portrait orientation, as with gestures.
